summary.headline: DENTIS: Largest shareholder Shin Ki-bong amends share pledge, KRW 7.51bn secured on 2.90m shares
summary.what_happened: On Nov 27, 2026, DENTIS filed a corrected report on a share pledge agreement tied to a change of largest shareholder, correcting figures after Hana Securities partially repaid a loan. The largest shareholder, Shin Ki-bong (CEO), has three cumulative share pledge contracts covering 2,903,670 shares, with total secured amounts of KRW 7,514.6m and total debt of KRW 5,500.3m.

key_numbers.label: Shares held by largest shareholder (as of filing date)
Shares held if all pledges are enforced

summary.why_it_matters: In Korea, filings on share pledges by major shareholders are generally disclosed so investors can see whether a controlling stake could be sold if loans are not repaid, since a pledge may be enforced if collateral falls below required levels. Corrections like this one usually reflect changes in loan balances or pledged share counts.
